Jordan (AE): Quick heads-up  HavenBank submitted SIG v2, flagged Q3.5 (data lineage for embeddings) and Q7.2 (KMS custody). They want itemized artifacts and a short one-paragraph response per question by EOD. Can we scope?
Priya (SE): I can draft the pipeline manifest and sanitized logs showing ingest -> embed -> store. Need confirmation on whether to reference customer buckets or generic "customer-dedicated storage" phrasing.
Lena (Security): Use "customer-dedicated storage" for the questionnaire. We'll attach the customer-specific diagram separately for the NDA copy. Also: clarify whether they expect HSM attestation docs or just KMS configuration.
Jordan (AE): They asked for attestation only if we manage keys. For CMK/BYOK, they just want confirmation keys are HSM-backed when requested.
Nico (Solutions Eng): Uploading sanitized diagram + manifest now: s3://redwood-evidence/havenbank/sig/manifest-2024-07-14.yaml and s3://redwood-evidence/havenbank/sig/flow-diagram-2024-07-14.png
ops-bot: file uploaded: manifest-2024-07-14.yaml, flow-diagram-2024-07-14.png :paperclip: 
Priya (SE): Pasting sanitized manifest snippet for Q3.5:
```
name: embeddings-pipeline
stages:
  - ingest:
      storage: customer-dedicated-s3
      encryption: SSE-KMS
  - embed:
      model: open-embed-v1
      cache: kv-store
  - persist:
      target: embeddings-store
      retention_days: 730
      access_control: RBAC
```
Lena (Security): Draft answer for Q3.5 (data lineage):
"Redwood provides an auditable pipeline manifest and architecture diagram that trace data from ingestion through embedding generation to persistent storage. Embeddings for the customer are written to customer-dedicated storage encrypted under KMS keys, with RBAC-enforced access and audit logging of all access and lifecycle events."
Lena (Security): Draft answer for Q7.2 (KMS/HSM custody):
"Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) through cloud KMS providers; customers can provision HSM-backed keys. If a customer opts for Redwood-managed keys, our default rotation cadence is 180 days and key rotation events are logged to audit trails. Customers may request HSM attestation packages for managed key scenarios; we will provide the requested compliance artifacts under the appropriate NDA."
Jordan (AE): Can someone attach the rotation cadence PDF and the KMS configuration checklist? Customer will want doc-level proof.
Nico (Solutions Eng): Uploaded: rotation-cadence-2024.pdf and kms-config-checklist-2024.pdf to s3://redwood-evidence/havenbank/sig/
ops-bot: files uploaded: rotation-cadence-2024.pdf, kms-config-checklist-2024.pdf :white_check_mark: 
Priya (SE): Also adding short deletion workflow note for evidence bundle: "On delete request we run a deterministic job that expunges objects, cryptographically erases keys where applicable, and records the job id in audit.log with retention per policy."
Lena (Security): Slight wording tweak to be safe: replace "cryptographically erases keys" with "retire/restrict keys per KMS provider best practices".
Jordan (AE): Perfect. I'll bundle the three paragraphs + links into a single answers.pdf and send to the customer. Please flag if anything missing.
Priya (SE): I'll convert the snippets to a single answers.txt and upload.
